non_negotiables.rule: Never close or confirm a change request without verified carrier download or official endorsement docs.
non_negotiables.description: Never confirm a change to the client or close the task before the carrier download or official endorsement document is verified against the original request.

non_negotiables.rule: Never bind an agency-bill endorsement before required payment or finance confirmation is received.
non_negotiables.description: Payment must be collected and the Accounting Policy Change checklist completed before binding any agency-bill change.

non_negotiables.rule: Never omit EZLynx change request task, notes, signed form, or required coverage selection form.
non_negotiables.description: All policy change requests must have an EZLynx task, complete notes, signed change forms, and signed coverage selections when coverages/limits change.

non_negotiables.rule: Quote-only requests must NOT be bound or submitted as endorsements.
non_negotiables.description: If client only requests a quote, label as 'Policy Change Request Quote' and do not process endorsement until approved and paid.

checkpoints.criteria: Verified caller identity, insured authority, and all affected policy numbers.
Clarified exact requested effective date and explicitly screened for known claims, losses, or accidents.
Evaluated whether change impacts other active policies, pending renewals, or underlying umbrella liability requirements.
Distinguished quote-only from live change request; applied 'Policy Change Request Quote' workflow if applicable.
Explained that coverage is pending carrier processing and set a clear timeline/follow-up expectation.
Universal: Mailing vs garaging. Personal: Reason, all household residents (Name, DOB, DL), own vs rent, registration match state, territory rate explanation. Commercial: Business location & filings.
Full name, DOB, DL/CDL#, state, residential address, relationship, student discounts (3.0+ GPA), distant student (100+ mi), driver training, commercial job duties/MVR.
Removal reason (moved, divorced, left employment), proof of other insurance or signed exclusion if still resident in household.
VIN, year/make/model, purchase date, garaging, lienholder, rideshare/Turo usage check, commercial radius/photos/weight.
Vehicle removal proof (Bill of Sale / Plate Surrender); Legal changes supported by official legal docs (Trust/LLC docs, divorce decree, death cert/executor docs, lienholder info).
Entered change on every applicable policy in EZLynx with detailed, structured memo.
Direct-bill changes submitted directly via carrier portal or official submission channel.
Endorsement quote obtained, Accounting Checklist completed, and payment collected prior to binding agency bill changes.
Escalated to Producer/Account Manager for commercial changes > $15k, disputed dates, coverage advice, or underwriting exceptions.

checkpoints.item: Reassign to CSR for Follow Up Task
checkpoints.criteria: Kept generated task open and reassigned to CSR for follow up with submission date and promised turnaround.
Routine carrier requests followed up twice at 48h intervals; time-sensitive requests (Certificates, AI, Waivers) called within 48h.
Matched carrier download/endorsement against original request (effective dates, drivers, VINs, deductibles, premiums, additional interests).
Discussion title 'Policy Change Request', Folder 'Policy Changes/Declarations', Labels 'Policy Change Request', 'Signed Change Form', 'Additional Policy' when applicable.

checkpoints.item: Client Center Delivery & Policy Change Processed Note
checkpoints.criteria: Confirmation docs shared via Client Center, EZLynx Details page updated, task closed with complete note, and closeout sent to client.
